import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Muse leaves the Reply card on `Waiting for agent response...` because SASE never copies mid-turn commentary into `live_reply.md`. The TUI follow is working. The Tools card updates because tool events still arrive on stdout.

**Cause.** Muse Code `1.4.13-R6996.1` writes assistant narration live to `$XDG_DATA_HOME/muse/sessions/.../<session-id>/session.jsonl` as `runtime.session` / `assistant_message_committed` with `phase: "commentary"`. The `--json` stdout stream SASE parses does not carry those lines. SASE only appends `live_reply.md` from stdout `run.output.delta`, and Muse emits that payload **once**, at the end of the whole turn, with the closing summary. A 21-minute / 131-tool run therefore keeps `live_reply.md` at 0 bytes until exit.

**Evidence.** While `bob-cli-cn.1` was still in `muse exec`, `live_reply.md` was empty, `tool_calls.jsonl` was 319+ lines and growing, and the session log was 6.5 MB with commentary already on disk. The same split showed up on in-flight apollo Muse runs (`ab--code`, `research.2i.mus`). A no-tool probe still emitted exactly one `run.output.delta` immediately before `run.terminal.completed`. Claude fills the card because its parser writes every assistant text block via `append_stream_text`.

**Fix.** Tail `session.jsonl` during `stream_and_parse_muse_json_output` (byte-offset, using existing `find_muse_session_log`). For each new `assistant_message_committed` with `phase: "commentary"`, call `append_stream_text`. Keep the existing delta path for the closing summary so it is not duplicated. Optional defense: if `live_reply.md` is still empty when `run.terminal.completed` arrives, write that text too. Recapture fixtures at R6996.1. Do not invent tool-progress prose, and do not dump `reasoning_summary_delta` into Reply.
